newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open firmer on Tuesday as the backwardation in London remained tight in spite of a further sharp hike in LME stocks.
The cash to three months backwardation was about $270 a tonne, at the upper end of Monday's range, and almost reaching the daily limit of $25.
Analysts expected the tightness in the LME spreads to last until the end of July, with some signs that some of it was being rolled over into August.
LME stocks rose 2,100 tonnes Tuesday to 143,300 tonnes.

COMEX September copper was called to open up 0.30 to 0.50 cent a lb from Monday's close at 106.30 cents. September was last traded on overnight ACCESS at 106.80 cents a lb, up 0.50 cents from Monday's close.
COMEX stocks Monday fell 2,379 short tons to 33,075 short tons.
